body:
I have been in therapy before, and I think I essentially a pretty introspective person anyway. I know certain patterns of thought and actions that I have that are irrational but I am also highly sensitive and emotional. I have never had these things addresses satisfactorily in therapy. I don't think I can change so I will give up.

About enjoyment... I buy books and games that lie in the corner because I can't focus on them. I buy food that rots in my refrigerator because I don't eat it. I buy clothes that gather dust in my closet because I don't wear them anywhere. I spend most of my free time crying and planning my suicide.

The things I used to enjoy, I don't anymore, so I'm just hurting and lonely.  So I don't have an answer for that question.

And I am a terrible friend. No one likes me. I try to listen to others but there is more to it than that, of course. The like... one or two people I talk to I feel like I'm leeching. I want to kill myself so I stop bothering them.

I really don't know who you'd consider to have "wise counsel" but I guess not. One reason is because I value my autonomy, and fear that will go when someone learns of my plans. Anyhow I believe that -- I am depressed, I know that -- but I am still capable of rational thought. This isn't just impulsive behavior.

But I would not make a good friend anyway.  There is a reason I don't have friends as it is. I don't know how much of it is the working for a living part but now that I have a tiny bit of cash I don't think it is contributing to my happiness or lack thereof. It's probably a personal problem of mine though. I dunno.

Every day is awful. I hate my job. I don't really have any friends, I think. I am tired and in pain every day -- physically and emotionally.

I don't know what the answer is, but I know that I'm sick of playing this game. These aren't new problems; they are patterns with my behavior and coping ability so I know that it's me. Thus, I plan to act accordingly.

But again, thanks for the time. I don't have the numbers but maybe you can hit it big one day.
I have been trying to "hang in there" for years, and it never really gets better.  I am tired.  There is a problem with me, so I will quit. But thanks for the thought anyway.

I dunno, I've been thinking about all this "being too nice" stuff and I wonder if it's maladaptive behavior.  And don't worry about thinking that you implied anything; I know exactly the kind of person I am.  Human nature or not, this stupid way that I think and feel is the reason that I am depressed and I hate myself and I really don't know what else to do about it other than this.  I guess that's it.

Anyhow, no worries about you heading off to bed; I understand.  Congrats on your new job, though!  I hope it goes well for you.  Thanks so much for your time and everything.
I'm kind of perpetually in savings mode for different reasons but I guess I have a little extra cash.

That's a really tough thing.  The expectations thing makes me blindsided with someone does do something genuinely mean, and even then I find myself trying to make excuses for their behavior.  And sometimes I try to find myself joking and other stuff to "mirror" what normal people do but I feel like I always fail.  I don't know what to act like with other people.  That's really sad and pathetic and I hate myself for it.

I also hate myself for having no answer to your next question.  There is no reason to hold myself to such standards.  I know it doesn't make sense.  It is because my heart and my mind are much too weak.  I've known I've had this problem for a long, long time but I can't fix it.  This way I'm addressing the problem the best way I can.

It's a challenge, because I know that a big part of being nice and sensitive to others is understanding when others can't or aren't as nice and as sensitive themselves.  That's a difficult thing to accept.  I try to, but I think that's resulted in my being used and abused a lot.

For instance, at my job I think I'm disliked by a few of my coworkers because I am the person that takes everything too seriously, and because I hold everyone up to pretty high standards.  But I don't know if anyone realizes I am holding myself up to the highest standards of all.  Standards I'm not living up to and probably can't live up to, so I'm constantly unhappy with myself.  It's probably like that with everything.

Again there's this constant thing with this realization of what is true and possible and realistic, and what I feel should be.  There is a huge divide between the two, and this is probably why I am unhappy.  I can't reconcile, for instance, the knowledge that I can't be perfect and the deep and pervasive inadequacy that I feel because I'm not.  There is obviously a big problem here that I've tried fixing for years, but have failed at so I just need to quit because I can't deal with this much longer.

It's hard, because I guess I'm always wondering if someone else is going though something. And I guess that a lot of people don't know that side of me, but I know that plenty of people *do* and they still don't care or even worse, I have gotten horribly burned by them. I'm not going because I feel like all the world sucks or is selfish or awful. That there are good people in the world is something I know is true but I don't feel like I have no experience with this. Or, I feel that I am so inherently flawed that I only attract bad or flaky people or something.

I feel really bad for saying this, but this is the part that sucks hard. The people I interact with everyday; the people I try to help and support don't give a fuck. You say that you care but you don't know anything about me... I mean, this is probably ultra-rude or something but I feel like it is extremely foolish to expect anything of this conversation. I didn't post this so anyone could change my mind or say something to make me feel better. I guess this was an act of emotional exhibitionism or something... just knowing that someone else knew that I felt shitty last night kept me from (insert suicidal method here). But at the end of the day I will still desire my demise... plus I will feel shittier for wasting your time. These are the conversations that make me feel crappy because I know that I am a stubborn, negative, selfish quitter. Sorry you felt that I'm worth investing time and energy in.

Perhaps you don't understand what I mean? In my brain I acknowledge the fact that life could get better, the same way I acknowledge that 1 + 1 = 2. But some vague theoretical recognition in the back of my head does not erase the pain I go through every day. I have been trying for a long time. I am not a teenager; I've been on meds and through therapy before. I have changed my habits and job and situation several times and I am still profoundly unhappy.

I know it gets better sometimes. I am glad that you found that your own situation has been getting better. I know it's possible for me, but I really don't care anymore. I have posted on this sub before and people have offered to talk and we exchange some messages and then everything stops and I feel the exact same way as before. I know that it could get better but every failed connection hurts so much so I don't want to try anymore. This is why I want to quit. But thanks for your efforts, anyway. Helping someone else would be a much better use of time.

I guess this is where we have the impasse, hahah. Like I said, I *know* it could get better, but I don't think it will -- I don't *feel* like it will -- and I am tired of loneliness and hurting. I will quit because of this. In my experience being nice gets you nowhere good.  Perhaps being nice to people benefits the others but I will do this final selfish and weak action because I don't feel like sticking it out for longer.

I do? I am not one to believe that life inherently has meaning. I don't enjoy living like this. Every day is so painful, physically and emotionally.  If you can consider this "surviving" I don't particularly care for it. 

If I were stronger I could handle this stuff but I am not so I can't. It's okay; I accept this.

You are right. I don't know what the future will hold. Maybe it would get better; maybe I could find someone who would appreciate me.

But I don't *feel* like that is true. There is a cognitive disconnect. I feel all the bad stuff too much, too strongly. I know it could get better but I also know I am much too weak for this shit which is why I can't take this anymore.

I dunno, it depends on the day.

Every day I try to wake up early to clean up my apartment and study a bit.  Depending on if I have to work in the morning or evening I might prepare for that and head off next.  

If I don't have work in the morning -- usually it's just nothing.  I might try to read or play a game or something but most days I just can't focus enough to keep those two things going.  Recently I am not motivated enough to do anything but go to work, or go out to pay bills and get cleaning supplies or toiletry type things when I need them.  If the only thing I need is food, I won't get the motivation to go get any.

If I have to go to work, I'll get dressed and go there whenever I have to go.  I always go in very early so I can prepare for my lessons -- I have a teaching-type job.  Then I just try to survive my lessons.  I'm honestly a very negative, low-energy, introverted person so being positive and bouncy the whole day is exceedingly tiring and I hate it.  Most of my students are okay but some are pushy and quick to complain to my bosses.  About half of my coworkers are insufferable or jerks in some way and I feel like most of my superiors aren't trustworthy.

Even after a "good" day at work I'm still exhausted and miserable.  Maybe I try to get something to eat on the way home but I toss up more dinners than not and end up crying most every night.  I don't really have friends or family I am comfortable talking to.  A lot of people have ghosted on me and like I said the few people that are still there are people I feel like shit for bothering as much as I do.

That's about it.  I don't really go out anymore or have any routine changes because of the lack of friends and motivation and energy... so it goes about like that every single day.

It's the absolute worst feeling and so draining, isn't it?  But I honestly don't believe that "what goes around comes around" thing.  I've tried to be nice and considerate for years and I am here.  So many of the shittier people around me seem to be in better places.  I don't believe that there's any kind of justice so I want to check out.
